name: Jason Wheeler
title: Vice President of Technology
quote:
I've had the pleasure of working with Mohammed Mubarak as our Lead Fullstack Developer for the past two years, and I can confidently say he's one of those rare engineers who combines technical excellence with genuine business acumen.

As the sole developer responsible for our marketing website at EF Academy, Mohammed has maintained and evolved our primary digital presence while simultaneously leading the development of critical backend applications for integration and data transformation needs. His ability to juggle both frontend excellence and complex backend systems speaks to his versatility as a true full-stack engineer.

Mohammed has been the backbone of our technology operations, keeping our systems running smoothly while continuously implementing new features that directly impact our users. His custom applications for Salesforce integration have streamlined our data workflows significantly, enabling seamless data uploads and transformations. One standout achievement was his implementation of a new integration layer using AWS Glue to replace our existing Tibco Scribe solution – a move that not only improved our system performance but also saved us $30,000 annually in licensing fees.

What really sets Mohammed apart is his approach to new projects. He doesn't just dive into coding – he conducts thorough research, presents multiple options with clear pros and cons, and helps guide decision-making from both technical and business perspectives. His backend applications consistently feature excellent UI/UX design, showing he truly understands the full user experience.

Mohammed delivers top-notch work consistently, and his collaborative approach makes complex technical decisions feel manageable. Whether it's maintaining our marketing website or architecting complex data integration solutions, I'd recommend him without hesitation for any software engineering project – he's the kind of developer every tech leader hopes to find. Any organization would be lucky to have Mohammed on their team.
